AKR796.XML.FILE_SQL: SELECT C.CLS_NO, A.FILE_CASE, CASE_NAME, COUNT(*) AS NUM FROM CLASS_MAIN C, CASE_MAIN CA, DOC_MAIN A,TRAN_D B WHERE C.PRIMARY_KEY = A.CLS_KEY AND A.CASE_KEY = CA.PRIMARY_KEY AND A.SOURCE_ORGNO=C.SOURCE_ORGNO AND A.SOURCE_ORGNO=B.SOURCE_ORGNO AND A.DOC_NO=B.DOC_NO AND B.SOURCE_ORGNO=$SOURCE_ORGNO$ AND C.DEPT_NO LIKE $DEPT_NO$ AND B.TX_CODE='20' AND B.ENTRY_DATE LIKE $YEARMONTH$ GROUP BY C.CLS_NO, A.FILE_CASE, CASE_NAME
AKR796.XML.UNINP_SQL: SELECT C.CLS_NO, D.FILE_CASE, CASE_NAME, COUNT(*) AS NUM FROM CLASS_MAIN C, CASE_MAIN CA, DOC_MAIN D WHERE C.PRIMARY_KEY = D.CLS_KEY AND D.CASE_KEY = CA.PRIMARY_KEY AND D.SOURCE_ORGNO=C.SOURCE_ORGNO AND D.DOC_STATE IN ('20','25') AND D.SOURCE_ORGNO=$SOURCE_ORGNO$ AND C.DEPT_NO LIKE $DEPT_NO$ AND (D.INPFILE_DATE='' OR D.INPFILE_DATE IS NULL) GROUP BY C.CLS_NO, D.FILE_CASE, CASE_NAME
AKR796.XML.INP_SQL: SELECT C.CLS_NO, D.FILE_CASE, CASE_NAME, COUNT(*) AS NUM FROM CLASS_MAIN C, CASE_MAIN CA, DOC_MAIN D WHERE C.PRIMARY_KEY = D.CLS_KEY AND D.CASE_KEY = CA.PRIMARY_KEY AND D.SOURCE_ORGNO=C.SOURCE_ORGNO AND D.SOURCE_ORGNO=$SOURCE_ORGNO$ AND C.DEPT_NO LIKE $DEPT_NO$ AND D.INPFILE_DATE LIKE $YEARMONTH$ AND D.KEEP_YEAR ＜＞ '99' AND (D.FILE_YEAR ＜＞ '' AND D.FILE_YEAR IS NOT NULL) AND (D.FILE_CLS ＜＞ '' AND D.FILE_CLS IS NOT NULL) AND (D.FILE_CASE ＜＞ '' AND D.FILE_CASE IS NOT NULL) AND (D.FILE_VOL ＜＞ '' AND D.FILE_VOL IS NOT NULL) AND (D.FILE_SEQ ＜＞ '' AND D.FILE_SEQ IS NOT NULL) GROUP BY C.CLS_NO, D.FILE_CASE, CASE_NAME
AKR796.XML.BOR_SQL: SELECT BT.FILE_CLS AS CLS_NO, BT.FILE_CASE, CASE_NAME, COUNT(BT.DOC_NO) AS NUM FROM CASE_MAIN CA, CLASS_MAIN C, BORROW_MAIN BM,BORROW_TRAN BT WHERE BM.SOURCE_ORGNO=$SOURCE_ORGNO$ AND CA.CASE_NO = BT.FILE_CASE AND CA.CLS_NO = BT.FILE_CLS AND CA.SOURCE_ORGNO = BT.SOURCE_ORGNO AND CA.SOURCE_ORGNO = C.SOURCE_ORGNO AND CA.CLS_KEY = C.PRIMARY_KEY AND BM.BOR_DATE LIKE $YEARMONTH$ AND BT.EXEC_TYPE IN ('1','2','3') AND BM.STATUS＞='3' AND BM.SOURCE_ORGNO=BT.SOURCE_ORGNO AND BM.BOR_NO=BT.BOR_NO AND C.DEPT_NO LIKE $DEPT_NO$ GROUP BY BT.FILE_CLS , BT.FILE_CASE, CASE_NAME
AKR796.XML.RET_SQL: SELECT BT.FILE_CLS AS CLS_NO, BT.FILE_CASE, CASE_NAME,COUNT(BT.DOC_NO) AS NUM FROM CASE_MAIN CA, CLASS_MAIN C, BORROW_MAIN BM,BORROW_TRAN BT WHERE BM.SOURCE_ORGNO=$SOURCE_ORGNO$ AND CA.CASE_NO = BT.FILE_CASE AND CA.CLS_NO = BT.FILE_CLS AND CA.SOURCE_ORGNO = BT.SOURCE_ORGNO AND CA.SOURCE_ORGNO = C.SOURCE_ORGNO AND CA.CLS_KEY = C.PRIMARY_KEY AND BM.BOR_DATE LIKE $YEARMONTH$ AND BT.EXEC_TYPE IN ('6','7') AND BM.STATUS＞='3' AND BM.SOURCE_ORGNO=BT.SOURCE_ORGNO AND BM.BOR_NO=BT.BOR_NO AND C.DEPT_NO LIKE $DEPT_NO$ GROUP BY BT.FILE_CLS , BT.FILE_CASE, CASE_NAME
